reason: Ten provider streaming/error findings from the round-4 providers audit (2, 3, 5, 7, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 17), all in src/nebula/v3/providers.py with two small consumers. (2) _stream_openai_compatible split SSE with httpx aiter_lines(), which follows str.splitlines() and breaks at U+2028/U+2029/U+0085; a gateway serialising with ensure_ascii=False sends those raw inside JSON strings, so one data frame became two unparsable halves and the whole streamed answer was discarded. A private framer now splits only on LF/CRLF/CR and joins multi-line data events. (3) With an OpenRouter upstream allowlist, a failed /v1/providers call was swallowed into an empty directory, every model was filtered out and health reported healthy=True with zero models blaming the allowlist; it now fails closed naming the directory outage. (5) An in-band {"error":{"code":503}} frame on a 200 stream was a plain ProviderError: never retried, and chat raised a non-retryable ChatError. _stream_error_frame maps transient codes to ProviderOverloadedError, _stream_with_retry peeks the leading frames so such a frame before any output is replayed under the same bounded policy, the ERROR event carries retryable=True, and chat re-raises it as ProviderOverloadedError so the API labels it a retryable provider failure. (7) Gemini's 'input token count ... exceeds' and Bedrock's 'Input is too long' rejections were generic ProviderErrors so compact-and-retry never ran; both markers are added and BedrockProvider.complete raises ProviderContextLengthError through _bedrock_failure. (10) data.get('model', default) returned a present null and the final ModelResponse failed validation after the full answer rendered; id/model now use `or`. (11) Usage without total_tokens recorded 0 so goal token budgets never tripped; _openai_usage sums prompt+completion in both the streaming and complete() paths. (12) A stream that closed without a finish_reason or [DONE] was persisted as a whole answer; it is now reported as ended early, while finish_reason='length' still completes and reaches the caller. (14) A 429 whose body says insufficient_quota (or billing_not_active/billing_hard_limit_reached) was retried three times and reported as a transient overload 'after 3 attempts'; it is now a ProviderQuotaError, never retried, with a non-retryable API handler. (15) Raw httpx transport exceptions escaped unwrapped and str(ReadTimeout) is empty, so the stream ERROR carried error=''; _send_with_retry/_stream_with_retry wrap them into ProviderError naming the failure. (17) Streaming tool-call deltas were keyed by int(item.get('index', 0)) so two index-less calls in one chunk merged into one malformed call, and id/name were concatenated across fragments; they are keyed by index, else id, else arrival order, taking id and name once. Rebase item: #428 routed the OpenRouter health probes through _send_with_retry, which retried a /models/user 429 to exhaustion and made test_openrouter_verified_key_does_not_hide_catalog_failure_or_use_public_models red on pristine main; health probes now pass retry_transient_statuses=False (connection failures still retry, per #428's intent) and _openrouter_health also catches the ProviderError an exhausted connection retry now becomes. Tests: test_stream_frames_are_split_only_on_sse_line_endings (2), test_openrouter_discovery_reports_a_failed_provider_directory (3), test_stream_error_frame_maps_transient_codes_to_overload, test_a_retryable_error_frame_before_any_token_is_replayed, test_an_exhausted_error_frame_is_labelled_retryable and tests/v3/test_chat.py::test_retryable_stream_error_surfaces_as_a_provider_overload (5), test_gemini_context_window_rejection_is_typed and test_bedrock_context_window_rejection_is_typed (7), test_stream_null_model_and_id_frames_keep_the_known_values (10), test_usage_without_total_tokens_is_summed_from_its_parts (11), test_stream_without_a_terminal_frame_is_not_a_clean_completion (12), test_quota_exhaustion_is_not_retried_or_called_an_overload (14), test_transport_failures_become_provider_errors_with_a_reason (15), test_streaming_tool_calls_are_keyed_by_index_or_arrival_order (17); each fails on origin/main and passes here, alongside every existing test in both files including the #428 health retry tests and the previously red 429 discovery test.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through src/nebula/v3/providers.py, chat.py and api.py) does not exercise SSE framing, in-band error frames, quota/transport error typing, Gemini/Bedrock context rejections or OpenRouter directory outages; the Python tests drive them directly with httpx.MockTransport. No full suites.
